about: The collecta of the formulary “19th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty and merciful God, graciously keep away from us all misfortune, that, unhampered in soul and body, we may perform with peaceful minds the works that are Yours. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
